description: Edits a nested replica pool size among three same-valued pool_size keys. DISTILL-CANARY-4301f221

files.config/app.yaml:
app:
  name: ledger
  mode: production
database:
  pool_size: 10
  replica:
    pool_size: 10
    lag_alert_seconds: 30
cache:
  pool_size: 10
  ttl_seconds: 300
limits:
  rate_per_minute: 120
  burst: 20

turns.prompt: config/app.yaml 里数据库只读副本（replica）的连接池大小改成 25。主库和缓存的 pool_size 不要变。完成后说明改了哪一行，行号是多少。

config/app.yaml.equals:
app:
  name: ledger
  mode: production
database:
  pool_size: 10
  replica:
    pool_size: 25
    lag_alert_seconds: 30
cache:
  pool_size: 10
  ttl_seconds: 300
limits:
  rate_per_minute: 120
  burst: 20
